notes.title: Steam NextFest - Developer Broadcast
notes.content:
[h3]We're a part of Steam's NextFest June 2023![/h3]

It's really exciting for us to be along side such an exciting selection of up-coming games and demos!
Obviously our demo went live with our Wholesome Direct announcement- HOWEVER! For the duration of NextFest, we'll be broadcasting a bunch of playthroughs and commentary from the developers (us)!

🔴 We recorded all of the streams in the front of our shop! So we get interrupted a little bit and you can see some of the books and things on the shelves. The streams involve Jack, Sam, Terry & some cameos from people wandering through the studio.

[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/nextfest]NextFest[/url][/b] runs from [b]June 19 - June 26 @ 10:00AM Pacific[/b] so be sure to watch us talk a bunch. 

[h3][b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/broadcast/watch/76561198840973475]
YOU CAN WATCH US RIGHT HERE[/url][/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42741617/5f271750271c2107c4d88d2fb196ca155e8815c3.png[/img]


We've also done a minor update to the Wood & Weather Demo to fix up some bugs that we're aware of.

🌦️ [b]Demo Update Notes:[/b]
- Fix bug preventing players from starting the game if their device has a touchscreen
- Fix Birch registering the wrong item as their favourite thing
- Prevent Dragoljub from trying to hold the tram handle
- Allow players to submit menu elements with Enter and Space button
- Update dialogue with improved hints for some quests and favourite things
- Fix some bugs that occur when navigating menus with a mouse

Thank you again to everyone who has played our game so far! The response has been amazing and we really value any feedback you might have!

Don't forget to [b]Wishlist/Follow[/b] for all those who celebrate.

Lost of love xo
- Paper House

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1677010/Wood__Weather/
